thread:
evelyn: FYI a canary produced a tiny but noisy quota blip on the console. digging shows proxy pingbacks and resume both incrementing token counters for same session.
tarun: I saw that at 11:42 UTC. two keepalive events 800ms apart, same user, route=chat-stream. console spike triggered an alert.
mike: quick glance at runtime logs: proxy keepalive had trace_id=null and runtime resume emitted trace_id=t-7f2e. console dedupe uses trace_id -> ended up double-counting.
evelyn: repro summary i used: open SSE, kill connection from client, proxy probes, then client reconnects with resume. both sides emit "keepalive" metric.
olga: proposal: add X-Ping-Origin header on proxy probes (values: proxy, runtime, client) and make billing emit only when origin!=proxy OR when resume confirmation received.
tarun: alternative short-term: delay finalizing quota charge for origin=proxy up to 400ms to see if resume fills trace_id. tradeoff: small delay but avoids most duplicates.
mike: long-term: propagate proxy.trace_id into resume handshake so every event for same session shares a flow_id. i can pick up PR for propagation.
evelyn: console UX: suggest we suppress the alert for this specific quota rule if the spike is dominated by origin=proxy events and under 5% of normal throughput. show a banner: "Likely proxy pingback noise; suppressed".
sre-bot: canary-deploy: started keepalive-origin-flag (build 6420) -> 10% edges. monitor window set to 15m.
olga: telemetry change: add field keepalive_source and tag possible_duplicate=true when trace_id was missing and later filled. that helps backfill correction.
tarun: we'll need a backfill to fix affected billing windows. estimated ~90min job. queueing now.
mike: opened PRs: #8120 (header + hold), #8124 (trace propagation). added unit tests for the 400ms hold path.
evelyn: nice. follow-ups: merge header patch, run backfill, add console banner copy, and add retro note. i'll create tickets.
olga: filing console mute for the alert group during backfill.
evelyn: closing thread. thanks all.
